messages:
sam: Quick bug report — SDK drops X-Impersonate-User header on retries, REST works fine.

sam: Repro with curl:

sam: ```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"X-Impersonate-User: user:42\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

sam: Node SDK example that loses it on 502 retry:

sam: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hello' }], headers: { 'X-Impersonate-User': 'user:42' } });
```

sam: Observed: first REST attempt honored impersonation; SDK retried once and subsequent request used service principal.

lina_dev: Oof, sample-apps use impersonation in e2e tests. Any idea why SDK strips it?

mike_platform: We sanitize headers and the retry builder reconstructs the request from a canonical map. We didn't include custom headers in that map. Also we intentionally blocked some headers to avoid accidental privilege escalation.

lina_dev: Security rationale is valid but we need parity or explicit opt-in. Breaking e2e tests is bad DX.

mike_platform: Agreed. Plan: 1) add explicit param chat.create({ impersonate: 'user:42' }) that maps to X-Impersonate-User server-side, 2) extend retry layer to preserve that param/headers across retries, 3) add unit+e2e tests.

sam: Please ensure new API is auditable (shows in logs who requested impersonation) and not just a raw header passthrough.

mike_platform: Will implement as first-class parameter so audits can pick it up. Also will add a config flag allowing opt-in for passing through arbitrary headers for advanced users (dangerous opt-in).

ci-bot: CI flake: sample-apps/e2e intermittently failing in PR #5142 — matches header-loss-on-retry.

lina_dev: Can you file a short RFC and include a migration note for SDK changelog and an example in the quickstart?
mike_platform: Yep. I'll open RFC + PR. tagging @sam for logs and exact curl output.
sam: Uploaded logs to the issue. Thanks — unblocked local runs with a tiny SDK patch.

lina_dev: Nice, once merged we should backport to the last patch release since many teams run pinned SDK versions.
mike_platform: I'll add a patch branch. Thanks everyone.
